methodNotes: Queue cityCode is matched directly to WUP city_code; ISO2 is checked.

An explicit registry cityId of wup2025:<city_code> is used first after checking country. Other registry and live rows use normalized full/parenthetical name aliases + matching country + nearest WUP coordinates, maximum 40 km; near-tied duplicate names are unresolved. Country and name alone are never accepted.
Population values are persons derived from source thousands. 2015–2025 average annual log growth is calculated as 100*ln(P2025/P2015)/10; null if baseline is missing.
The supplied normalized JSON lacks WUP city-level 0–3 quality flags; those remain null. The existing 2025 plausibility label is retained separately when present.
Further Wikidata queries were left off after the public SPARQL endpoint began rate-limiting to 1 request/min; only three verified returned GeoNames sitelinks are retained.
Coalesced app-only Washington into canonical Washington, D.C. after same-country name alias and 2.78 km center check; retained app source ID and source coordinates on canonical row.

Wikipedia links are included only when the linked article is about the candidate city/town/municipality; broader administrative-area pages are rejected. A focused manual scope audit on 2026-10-07 corrected Nandail and Golapganj, removed unsupported Lakhai and Bahubal links, and added verified settlement pages in English, Bengali, and Chinese. The original API-derived links and rejected evidence are retained in wikipediaEvidence where reviewed.

The October 8 follow-up adds one distinct Iravipuram village row without transferring population or configured status from the distant WUP Kollam point. Other enrichment-run counters retain their original snapshot meaning.

The October 8 Central Asia capitals integration adds four non-WUP capital rows with no transferred population values. Astana has an accepted app entry scoped to Esil district 254; Bishkek has a verified partial official geometry sample held from runtime pending local geometry QA. Dushanbe and Ashgabat document official registry/portal existence without public parcel geometry.

October 8 African-capital research adds 43 distinct city seats with chosen query locators and no inferred WUP populations. Three accepted city entries are linked to runtime sources; Porto-Novo and Victoria geometry is verified but held for material overlap; Porto-Novo also has self-intersections. This includes separately labelled associated/transitional seats and a disputed/de facto supplement.
